content:
**Organ Cave** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.

Before the Great War, a geology student from Vault-Tec University became trapped here while investigating reports of deep red groundwater. [1] 

A location in The Forest, inhabited by Cult of the Mothman. The cave system is accessible from the south, north, and west.

Human remains can be seen in cages and chains here. Cultists can be seen going about their lives, performing various tasks, such as digging, sharpening knives, foraging mushrooms, or cooking. In one river tunnel, human bones have been propped up in front of a powerful light to cast a giant shadow depicting a Mothman upon the wall.

The eye of an art deco sculpture of a face (metroman.nif) is visible through a crack in the wall, in a tunnel near the room with many cages. The sculpture is identical to other buried sculptures in the setting, seen at locations such as Lucky Hole Mine, Tanagra Town, and Dunwich Borers.

Organ Cave appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.

A real-world cave of the same name exists in Greenbrier County, West Virginia.
